summary: This informational document describes KCipher-2, a stream cipher with a 128-bit key and a 128-bit initialization vector. Its algorithm was published in 2007 and has been evaluated in academic and industrial studies; no vulnerabilities had been found at the time. It is fast thanks to simple operations.

eli5.summary: This describes a secret-code machine that scrambles data quickly by making a long stream of mixed-up numbers.
